title: OpenAI adds Google Cloud as a computing supplier

sources.quote: The ChatGPT developer has finalized a deal to utilize Alphabet's (GOOGL) Google cloud services to meet its increasing need for computing capacity, Reuters reported.
As reported by Reuters, OpenAI finalized a deal last month to begin tapping Google Cloud's powerful infrastructure, including its custom TPU chips.

explain: OpenAI reportedly agreed in May 2025 to rent extra computing from Google Cloud, a rival, to keep up with demand for ChatGPT. The deal was reported by Reuters from anonymous sources; no amount was disclosed.
